subject: Auto-casting self rites: set_autocast has a house cast a self rite by itself each tick it falls due, kept up (every_ticks 0: whenever it isn't in force) or every N ticks, only while keep_aether is left after paying; clear_autocast stops it. They cast in the order first set, right after rites run out, so one kept up never lapses. One that can't tells the house once (autocast_held) until it casts again. GET /me lists them (autocasts)
